m920156.くふふふ……さぁキホルよ、\n虫たちの指揮をとるのだ。\n妾のための、妾の王国の:
Mmm… now, Kihor,
take command of the bugs.
Become the foundation of my kingdom, for me!
m920156.ここに来る途中にね、デーモンシェフから\nキホルちゃんのこと色々聞いたよ。:
On my way here, I heard a lot about Kihor-chan
from the Demon Chef.
m920156.この森には食材と魔力が満ちている。\nグルメジャングル、まさしく奇跡の生態系だな:
This forest is brimming with ingredients and mana.
The Gourmet Jungle is truly a miraculous ecosystem.
m920156.こらー！！ 飛んで逃げるなんて卑怯だぞー！！: Hey!! Fleeing by flying is such a cowardly move!!
m920156.ごめんね、チョコの準備してたら遅くなっちゃった。\n模擬戦が終わったら、皆でチョ:
Sorry, I got a bit late preparing the chocolate.
After the mock battle, we're having a chocolate party, everyone♪
m920156.さぁ、デモシェフ商会職員たちも存分に力を付けよ！\n魔界料理がお前達に力を分けて:
Now then, staff of the Demon Chef's Guild, draw on your full strength!
The Demon World cuisine will share its power with you!
m920156.じゃあ友だちだね！\nあっ、後で魔界料理教えてもらっていい？:
Then we're friends!
Oh, can you teach me some Demon World recipes later?
m920156.そう、か……そうだな……。\n俺たちは恋人たちの愛を守っていたのか！:
I see… I suppose so…
We were protecting the love of the couples!
m920156.そう、そうなんです！\nなので王子の記録については、\nしっかり正確に残しておき:
Exactly!
So I want to make sure the records
about the Prince are accurate and thorough.
m920156.そう、俺たちはいわば愛の守護者。\n人知れず恋人たちを守る騎士様なのさ……。:
That's right, we are, in a sense, guardians of love.
Knights protecting the lovers, unseen by the world…
m920156.そういうわけだ。\nだから今日の模擬戦も、チョコなんて忘れて――:
Exactly.
So let's forget about the chocolate and focus on today's mock battle――
m920156.そういうわけだから、\nなんとしてでも襲撃犯を捕まえて――: That's why we absolutely have to catch the culprits――
m920156.そうだね。ついでに事件の黒幕も\n引きずりだしたいところだけど……。:
That's right. I'd also like to drag out the mastermind
behind this incident, but…
m920156.そう！ そうなんだよ！\nあたしが取り寄せてた材料も盗まれちゃったし！:
Right! Exactly!
Even the ingredients I had ordered were stolen!
m920156.そしてキホル、お前は相手がどんな存在であろうと、\n絶対に許せないことがあったは:
And Kihor, no matter who the opponent is,
there is something you absolutely cannot forgive.
m920156.その可能性は否定できませんね……。\n王子、どうやら今回の事件には裏がありそうで:
We cannot rule out that possibility…
Prince, it seems there is more to this incident than meets the eye.
Shall we begin our own investigation?
m920156.その小娘にばかり気を取られていて良いのか？\n妾の軍勢が、もうひとつの門を破った:
Is it wise to be so distracted by that little girl?
My army has breached another gate.
m920156.その覚悟がないなら、\n安易に助けようなどと思わな――:
If you don't have that resolve,
don't think so lightly of helping her—
m920156.それで、前にドラコレックスと戦った、\n強者である王子そっくりのチョコを生み出し:
So that's why it created a chocolate replica of the Prince,
a true powerhouse, back when we fought Dracorex…
m920156.それでは、第一回王国料理大会エキシビジョン！\n魔界料理人ｖｓ天界料理人！ 模擬:
Then, the First Kingdom Cuisine Tournament Exhibition!
Demon World Cook vs. Celestial World Cook! Mock battle―begin!
m920156.それはな、俺たちがずっと戦場にいるからだ！！: It's because we're always stuck on the battlefield!!
m920156.ただ街全体に配置するには、\nちょっと数が足りないんだよね……。\nうーん、どう:
But we don't have quite enough of them
to cover the whole city...
Hmm, what should we do?
m920156.だが、無事に無力化し、\nフェロモンの効果が切れても、\n仲間にできるとは思わな:
But even if you manage to neutralize her safely
and the pheromones wear off,
don't think you can make her a friend.
m920156.でも、だからこそ\n最高の食材が待ってるってことだよね！:
But that means the best ingredients
are waiting for us in here, right?
m920156.でもな、俺は思うんだ。\n俺たちが王国と協力して戦っているから、\n街の連中が平:
But you know what I think?
Because we're fighting alongside the Kingdom,
the folks in town can enjoy their love lives in peace.
m920156.ともかく、急いで情報を集めます！\n何だか嫌な予感がしますからね！: Anyway, I'll gather intel quickly! I've got a bad feeling about this.
m920156.どうみても魔法生物だね……！\nそれに偽王子のまわりのチョコ、\nなんだか活発に:
It's clearly a magical creature…!
Also, the chocolates around the fake Prince
seem to be getting more active!
m920156.なっ……オーガスタ嬢、舐めてもらっては困るぞ。\nあのチョコ細工技術を身につける:
W-What! Miss Augusta, please don't underestimate us!
Do you have any idea how much training
we endured to master that chocolate sculpting technique?
m920156.なっ……何だあのナイフさばきは！？\nチョコがまたたく間に等身大デーモンチョコに:
W-What is that knife work?!
In an instant, the chocolate has become a life-sized Demon Chocolate!
m920156.なっ……大変です！\n試作・等身大デーモンチョコ細工に！\n魔界アリが殺到してい:
W-What is this?!
A swarm of Demon Realm Ants is rushing in!
They're going for the life-sized Demon Chocolate figurine!!
m920156.なっ……話を聞いて……。\n――はぁ、そうだったな、エレット嬢は\n王子と共に戦:
W-wait… listen to me…
—Hah, that's right. Miss Ehret was a priest warrior
who fought alongside the Prince.
m920156.なるほど、植物が自己防衛に、\n毒を持ったり、溶解液を持ったりするのと同じと。:
I see. It is similar to how plants
use poison or dissolving fluids for self-defense.
m920156.なんだそのふざけたチョコレート像は！？: What is that ridiculous chocolate statue?!
m920156.ね、ねぇレーヴさん！\nこれはどう書き残すの！？:
R-Reve!
How am I supposed to write this down!?
m920156.ねぇ女王様、こいつら無視して、\nもっといっぱいチョコを奪いにいこ？:
Hey, Your Majesty, let's ignore them.
Shall we go snatch some more chocolate?
m920156.はぁ……はぁ……。\n虫の数が多すぎて、きりがないよ……！:
Haa… haa…
There are too many insects… it's endless…!
m920156.はぁい♪ たぁんと食べてねぇ♪\nあなたには、魔王様が死んだなんて嘘をつく、\n:
Yes, ma'am~♪ Eat up~♪
You need to defeat those humans
who lied about His Majesty the Demon King being dead.
m920156.はぁ？ ガリウス様は死なないもん。\n取り消せ人間！ 今すぐガリウス様に謝って！:
Hah? His Majesty the Demon King doesn't die.
I take it back, human! Apologize to His Majesty right now!
m920156.はぁ～？\nクソ裏切り者のクソデーモンが何か言ったぁ～？\n友だちなんていらない:
Haa~?
Did that shitty, treacherous demon just say something?
I don't need any friends!
m920156.はぁ～？ まだ言ってるの？\nキホルちゃんはぁ、自分で望んでここにいるの！:
Hah? Are you still talking?
I'm here because I want to be!
m920156.はい……ただ、今回の事件は虫の習性という、\n単純な理由だけではないようなんです:
I know… but it seems this incident isn't just about
a simple insect instinct.
m920156.はい、襲撃された商隊への聞き込みと、\n現場に残された痕跡の検証が終わりました。:
Yes. I've finished questioning the survivors of the raided caravan
and examining the traces left at the scene.
m920156.はっ……まさかセレモニー用の「アレ」を……？: Y-Yes… You wouldn't actually use “that” ceremonial item…?
m920156.はっ、そうでした！\n当日までは内緒にしないとですよね。:
Ah, that's right!
We have to keep it a secret until the day itself, don't we.
m920156.はっ？ はぁ～！？\nどうして私が働かなきゃいけないの！？:
Huh? Wha—?!
Why do I have to work?!
m920156.はて、もうフェロモンが切れたか。\nキホルよ、フェロモンチョコを食わせてやるがよ:
I wonder, have the pheromones already worn off?
Kihor, feed her some pheromone chocolate.
m920156.ふぅ、お菓子は専門外なので、\nさすがに本物には負けてしまいますが、\nこんなと:
Phew. Sweets aren't really my specialty,
so I suppose I can't quite match the real thing,
but how about these?
m920156.ふぅ、魔界アリ討伐完了！\n……あれ、でもどうしてこんなところに、\n魔界アリが:
Phew, Demon Realm Ants eliminated!
...But why did they show up here of all places...?
m920156.ふざけるな……そんなチョコ細工ごときに、\nどうして妾が敗北しなければならぬ……:
Don't joke with me… Why must I lose
to a trinket like that chocolate sculpture…!
m920156.ふっふっふ、商売と恋愛は似ている。\n作戦と駆け引き、そして育まれる信頼！\n我:
Heh heh heh. Business and romance are alike.
Strategy, negotiation, and the trust that is built!
We aim for the highest quality chocolate!!
m920156.ふふ、これもまだ試作のうち。\nされど虫たちの注意を引くには十分！！:
Hehe, this is still just a prototype.
But it is more than enough to draw the insects' attention!!
m920156.ふふ、キホルさんも中々の腕前で。\nですが王子への悪口は許しません。\n香辛料に:
Heh, Kihor, you're not half bad yourself.
But I won't tolerate insults toward the Prince.
Not from a half-baked cook who relies so heavily on spices!
m920156.ふふ、チョコ作戦大成功ですね。\nこの調子で街中の虫を掃討しましょうか。:
Heh, the chocolate operation was a great success.
Let's keep this up and clear out the pests from the streets.
m920156.ふふ、効かぬなら、効くように作り変えればよいこと。\nそう……料理することによっ:
Fufu, if they don't work, one simply modifies them to make them work.
That's right… through cooking!
m920156.ふふ、殿方は鈍感なものなのですわ。\nもちろん、私たちの王子も。:
Hehe, men are just so oblivious.
Including our Prince, of course.
m920156.ふふ、騒がしい料理対決になってしまいましたが、\nどうにか一件落着ですね。:
Heh, it was quite a lively cooking showdown, but
I'm glad we managed to settle this peacefully.
m920156.ふふっ、それならもう完成していますよ！\nさぁ王子、思う存分召し上がってください:
Heh, then it's already done!
Now then, Prince, please help yourself to your heart's content!!
m920156.ふふっ、分かっているなエレット！\n無事に帰ったら、試食は私に任せてくれ！:
Hehe, I knew you'd understand, Ehret!
Once we get back safely, leave the tasting to me!
m920156.ほら、噂をすれば♪\n王子、そろそろ休憩も終わりだよね。\nグルメジャングルの奥:
Well, well~♪
Prince, I think our break is over.
Let's head deeper into the Gourmet Jungle!
m920156.ほれ、キホルよ、\n残りのフェロモンチョコを喰らうがよい。\n憧れの魔王様を害し:
There, Kihor.
Devour the rest of the pheromone chocolate.
Will you not kill the human who harmed the Demon King you admire?
m920156.ほんと、困ったものですよねぇ。\n――さて、私たちもパーティ会場に行きましょうか:
Really, it's such a headache.
―Now then, let's head to the party venue!
m920156.みんな、虫たちがチョコに食いついてる隙に、\nどんどん攻撃をあびせて倒しちゃおう:
Everyone, while the pests are busy gnawing on the chocolate,
let's land as many hits as we can and take them down!
m920156.むぅ、確かに。\nこれは調査してみる必要がありますね……。:
Mmm, that's true.
We'll need to investigate this...
m920156.むぅぅ、今の時期にチョコを狙うなんて、\n許せない魔物さんですね……！:
Mmm… targeting chocolate at a time like this…
Those monsters are truly unforgivable…!
m920156.むぅぅ、料理のジャンルを限定しておくべきだったか。\n互いに得意料理を繰り出し続:
Hmph… I should have limited the genres of cuisine.
If they keep unleashing their signature dishes,
it's only natural the match ends up a stalemate…
m920156.むっ……下がれエレット嬢、オーガスタ嬢！\nこのむせ返るような香りは……！\n女:
Hmph… Step back, Miss Ehret, Miss Augusta!
This suffocating scent…!
The Queen Spider is being controlled by pheromones!
m920156.むっ、私もお菓子には一家言あるぞ。\nぜひとも一緒につくろうじゃないか。:
Hmph, I have my own strong opinions on sweets.
I'd be delighted to make some with you.
m920156.むむっ、この等身大デーモンチョコを見るに、\nもはやチョコ細工技術は十分では……:
Mmm, looking at this life-sized Demon Chocolate,
isn't our craftsmanship already sufficient...?
I'd say we could make a statue out of chocolate.
m920156.も、燃えてる……！\nふたりの間に燃え盛る炎が見えるみたいだよ！:
Wh-whoa… it's burning…!
I can practically see the flames roaring between the two of them!
m920156.もうっ、試食だけじゃなくて一緒に作ろうよ！\nレギーナさんのチョコ、あたしも食べ:
Come on! Let's make some together, not just taste them!
I'd love to try the chocolate you make, Regina♪
m920156.もしかして、誰かが魔界アリを使って、\nチョコレートを集めてるってことだったり？:
Could it be that someone is using the Demon Realm Ants
to gather up chocolate?
m920156.もちろん♪\nよぉし、みんなで幻のカカオ豆を見つけよう！: Of course♪ Alright, everyone, let's find those legendary cacao beans!
m920156.もっと、もっと虫をけしかけて……。\n魔王様を傷つけた人間どもに……罪をつぐなわ:
More… send more bugs…
Make the humans who hurt the Demon King… atone for their sins…
m920156.よぉし、バレンタイン同盟のらぶぱわー！\n虫たちに思い知らせてやるんだから！: Alright, Valentine Alliance, love power! We'll show those insects a thing or two!
m920156.よぉし、バレンタイン同盟結成だね！\nまずは街に潜伏してる虫をおびき出そう！:
Alright, the Valentine's Alliance is formed!
First, let's lure out the pests hiding in the city!
m920156.よし、助けるよ！\nあたし、あの子を助けるから！:
All right, I'll save her!
I'm going to save that girl!
m920156.わぁぁぁっ！？\nほらっ、こうなるから早くって！！:
Waaah?!
I told you! I told you we should have moved it sooner!
m920156.わたくしの民は……どこ……どこに……。\nああっ……熱い……身体が熱い……っ！:
My people… where… where are they…
Aah… it's hot… my body is burning…!
m920156.エイルさん！\nもしかして、調査の結果が？:
Eir!
Could it be… you have the results of your investigation?
m920156.エレット……なるほど、王国軍が助けてくれたのね。\nまた世話をかけてしまったよう:
Ehret… I see. The Kingdom's army came to our rescue.
It seems we've put you to more trouble…
m920156.エレット嬢、おそらくキホルは、\nフェロモンチョコを食べさせられているのだ。\n:
Miss Ehret, Kihor is likely being forced to eat pheromone chocolate.
Chocolate that she herself made.
m920156.エレット嬢、キホルはデーモンだぞ。\nなぜ異種族であるデーモンに、\nそこまで肩:
Miss Ehret, Kihor is a demon.
Why do you support a demon, a different species,
so wholeheartedly…?
m920156.オーガスタさんと、キホルちゃんが料理対決！？: A cooking duel between Augusta and Kihor-chan?!
m920156.オーガスタさんとキホルさんの料理勝負、\nこれで最後の十品目ですか……。:
Augusta and Kihor's cooking duel…
Is this the last of the ten courses…?
m920156.オーガスタ嬢！ キホル！\nこれが最後の勝負だ！ オーダーは……！\n――戦士た:
Augusta! Kihor!
This is the final showdown! The order is…!
―Cuisine that will rouse the warriors' spirits!!
m920156.キホル、どうして不貞腐れているのだ。\nまだ腹の中にフェロモンが残って――:
Kihor, why are you being so sullen?
There are still pheromones left in your stomach—
m920156.キホルちゃんもね、まだつんつんしてるけど、\n料理してる時はすっごく楽しそうだよ:
Kihor-chan is still being a bit stubborn,
but she looks really happy when she's cooking!
m920156.キホルちゃん特製、魔界クッキング！！\nクソザコ王子、むせび泣きながら食べなさい:
Kihor-chan's special, Demon World Cooking!!
You worthless Prince, eat it while sobbing your eyes out!!
m920156.キホルちゃん！！\n王子、早くキホルちゃんを止めないと！:
Kihor-chan!!
Prince, we have to stop her quickly!
m920156.キホルは友だちがいないからな。\nこれを機に皆と仲良くなってくれたら――:
Kihor doesn't have any friends, you know.
I hope this gives you a chance to get along with everyone—
m920156.シャルキーちゃん急いで王子を呼んできて！\nあたしはここで、村を防衛してるから！:
Sharqi-chan, hurry and get the Prince here!
I'll hold the line and defend the village!
m920156.ジェイク、それは早計ですよ。\nオーガスタさんのこのスープの繊細さ、\nひとくち:
Jake, that's a bit premature.
Just one sip of Augusta's soup, and you'll be able to tell how exquisite it is.
m920156.デモシェフ商会のチョコは大打撃を受けてたけど、\n王国軍と共闘してる姿を見た\n:
The Demon Chef Company's chocolate took a big hit,
but seeing them cooperate with the Royal Army
has gotten donations pouring in from the townspeople.
m920156.デーモンシェフさん……！！\nわかった、一緒にバレンタインを守ろう！！:
Demon Chef...!
I understand. Let's protect Valentine's Day together!
m920156.デーモンシェフだってデーモンでしょ？\n一緒に生きていける、もしかしたら友だちに:
You're a demon too, Demon Chef, aren't you?
Maybe we can live together, or even become friends.
Demons and humans aren't so different.
m920156.レーヴさんって真面目だよね。\nこういうの、全部書き残しているの？:
Reve, you're so serious.
Do you write down every single detail like this?
m920156.一進一退、審査員のみんなも\nどっちに票を入れるか決めかねてるみたいだね。:
It's neck and neck. The judges
seem torn about who to vote for.
m920156.両方の料理を食べた、王子なのでは……？: The Prince, who ate from both sides…?
m920156.事件が終わったばかりなのに、\nふたりとも元気だなぁ……じゃなかった！: They're both so energetic, even right after that incident… Wait, no!
m920156.人を幸せにする料理を、\n人を操るために使うなんて……許せませんね……。: To use a dish meant to bring people happiness… for the sake of controlling them? I simply cannot forgive that…
m920156.今の王子は天界と魔界、両方の料理を食べた状態。\nもはや普段の倍は強い王子\nと:
The Prince has just eaten from both the Celestial and Demon Worlds.
Saying he's twice as strong as usual
wouldn't be an exaggeration!
m920156.仲が悪いよりはいいんじゃないかな。\nそれよりエレット、こっちも準備を始めよう。:
Isn't that better than them getting along badly?
Anyway, Ehret, let's get started on our preparations too.
I'll go call the Prince's units.
m920156.何か攻撃を引きつける手段があれば……。\nあ、あたしが最前線に出て注意を引けば―:
If only we had a way to draw their fire…
Ah, if I go to the front line and distract them—
m920156.俄然やる気が出てきたぞ！\nこの模擬戦、我々が勝利するッ！！:
My motivation has just skyrocketed!
We shall win this mock battle!!
m920156.元気がいいのは良いことですよ。\nそれでは模擬戦――開始です！:
Being energetic is a good thing.
Now then, the mock battle—let's begin!
m920156.嗚呼、恋人たちの喜ぶ顔が目に浮かぶ！\n愛は育まれ、商売の時が始まる！\nさぁ、:
Ah, I can already picture the joy on the faces of the lovers!
Love will be nurtured, and the time for business has come!
Now then, let's get our wonderful, delicious chocolate into circulation!!
m920156.困ったものだな……。\nこれはしばらく、物質界の実地体験が必要か。:
She's a handful….
I suppose she needs some practical experience in the Material World for a while.
m920156.大きい……いえ、それだけじゃありません。\nこのサイズのチョコ細工だというのに、:
It's huge… No, that's not all.
For a chocolate sculpture of this size,
there is absolutely no unevenness in the materials…!!
m920156.女性の皆さんはオーガスタさんの料理をどうぞ！\n模擬戦前に、めいっぱい力をつけま:
Ladies, please enjoy Augusta's cuisine!
Let's fill ourselves with power before the mock battle!
m920156.女王蜘蛛さんと、\nキホルさんを助けなきゃいけないのに！: I have to save Queen Spider and Kihor!
m920156.女王蜘蛛さんも、キホルちゃんも、\nこの街も、全部ぜんぶ取り戻すよー！！: We'll get back everything—the queen spider, Kihor, this city, everything!!
m920156.女王蜘蛛さん！ キホルちゃん！\n良かった、正気に戻ったんだね！:
Queen Spider! Kihor!
I'm so glad you're back to your senses!
m920156.女王蜘蛛さん！ 大丈夫！？\nどこか怪我してるの！？:
Queen Spider! Are you okay?!
Are you hurt somewhere?!
m920156.実はキホルが、\nオーガスタさんに喧嘩を売っているようで……。\nそれもなんと、:
It seems Kihor has challenged Augusta to a fight…
And it's a cooking duel, of all things.
m920156.市街に入ってしまえば、\n人間が虫に追いつけるはずもなし。:
Once they're inside the city,
humans have no chance of catching up to insects.
m920156.市街地に魔界アリが侵入したらしいの！\n早くこの……デーモンチョコ？ をしまわな:
Demon Realm Ants have invaded the city!
We need to put this... Demon Chocolate? away quickly――
m920156.彼女は人一倍、忠誠心の強いデーモンだった。\n支えを失ったキホルを、\n魔王様の:
She was a demon of exceptional loyalty.
Whether we can support Kihor, who has lost her pillar of strength,
in place of His Majesty the Demon King…
m920156.我々は商売人、恋人たちの愛を繋ぐチョコ職人！\nなればバレンタインを守護するのも:
We are merchants, artisans of chocolate who connect lovers' hearts!
Guarding Valentine's Day is
none other than our sacred duty!
m920156.戦いよりも料理が大好きで、\n人間のことは大嫌いだけど、\n誰かが傷つくところは:
She loves cooking more than fighting,
and she hates humans,
but she can't stand seeing anyone get hurt. That's what I heard.
m920156.書き残す前に本物の王子に報告です！\nた、助けてくださーい！！:
Before I write anything, I need to report to the real Prince!
P-Please help us!!
m920156.最近は商隊の襲撃が\n増えてるからって警備を増やしてたけど、\n狙われた積荷はチ:
We've been increasing the guard patrols lately because
attacks on caravans have been on the rise, but
it seems the targeted cargo has been nothing but chocolate.
m920156.死力を尽くして戦ったのだ。\nもはや戦友といっても良いだろう。:
We fought with everything we had.
I suppose it's fair to call us comrades-in-arms now.
m920156.然り然り。\n魔王ガリウス様に逆らった、\n愚かな物質界の民を苦しめてやろうぞ。:
Indeed.
Let us torment these foolish Material World citizens
who dared to defy Demon Lord Galious.
m920156.物質界の連中ぜーんぶ！\nキホルちゃんと女王様のフェロモンチョコで、\nめろめろ:
Every last one of the Material World!
I'll make them all swoon and flutter
with my and Your Majesty's pheromone chocolate~♪
m920156.物質界連合軍の一員として、\n俺たちが模擬戦に出ている間にも――:
As members of the Material World Coalition,
even while we're out here in this mock battle――
m920156.物質界連合軍の皆さんも、\nなんだか友情が深まったような顔してますよ？:
The members of the Material World Coalition seem to have
grown quite close, don't you think?
m920156.王国主催で、街の皆さんにチョコを振る舞うのです。\nもちろん、みなさんも来てくれ:
It is hosted by the Kingdom, and we will be serving chocolate to the townspeople.
Of course, you are all invited to join us, right?
m920156.王子、あたしたちも市街に入った虫を倒しにいこう。\n街も、あの子も、全部守らなき:
Prince, let's go take out the bugs that have entered the city.
We have to protect the town, and that girl, all of it!
m920156.王子、ちょっと虫が多すぎるよ！\n前に出たら集中砲火にあっちゃう！:
Prince, there are too many bugs!
If we push forward, we'll get swarmed!
m920156.王子、急いでふたりを止めに――\nうぅん、むしろ試食しに……？ 行かないと！:
Prince, we need to hurry and stop them—
Or rather, go taste-test them... We have to go!
m920156.王子、此度の騒動もお疲れさまでした。\nそれから――はっぴーばれんたいん、です♪:
Well done, Prince, for handling this commotion.
And—happy Valentine's Day♪
m920156.王子が手伝ってくれるなら心強いよ！\nよぉし、あたしも頑張るからね！:
It's a huge help having the Prince on our side!
Alright, I'll do my best too!
m920156.王子だって、皆だって、\nきっとそう言うと思うよ！:
I'm sure Prince, and everyone else,
would say the same!
m920156.王子よ、デモシェフ商会総員で、\nこの付近にデーモンのチョコ細工を配置した。\n:
Prince, the entire Demon Chef Company has deployed
demon chocolate decorations in this area.
Use them effectively as shields…!!
m920156.甘い、甘いぞ副デーモンシェフ。\n人類の恋愛に妥協は許されないと、\n先日従業員:
Sweet talk, Deputy Demon Chef.
Have you forgotten what our employee Efne told me the other day?
There is no compromise when it comes to human romance.
m920156.甘いものが目的じゃなくて、\nチョコレートを奪うのが目的ってことかぁ……。:
So it's not just about the sweetness…
they want the chocolate itself, huh…
m920156.甘いチョコと共に、想い人に気持ちを伝えるとは。\n物質界にはこんなにときめく催し:
Expressing your feelings to a loved one with sweet chocolate.
So the Material World has such a thrilling event.
m920156.甘い匂い……つまりチョコレートに引き寄せられたと？: The sweet smell... meaning they were attracted by the chocolate?
m920156.結論から言って、\n今回のチョコ輸送商隊襲撃事件の犯人は、\n魔界アリの群れに間:
To get straight to the point,
the culprits behind this chocolate transport caravan attack
appear to be a swarm of Demon Realm Ants.
m920156.虫の習性として、ありえない話ではないですね。\n荷馬車の襲撃とも関係があるのかも:
It's not an impossible theory, given insect behavior.
It might be related to the wagon attack as well...
m920156.蜘蛛ぉー！？\n魔界アリだけでも大変なのに、\n蜘蛛の糸に絡め取られたら、攻撃が:
Spiders?!
The ants are bad enough, but if they get tangled in spider silk,
we won't be able to fight properly!
m920156.街のみなさんも、\n世界のために戦ってる兵士さんたちに、\nお礼のチョコを贈りた:
The townspeople said they wanted to
give the soldiers who fight for the world
some chocolate as a thank-you, after all…
m920156.見間違いじゃないよね！？\n王子がふたりいるし、人型のチョコが踊ってるし！:
You're not seeing things, right!?
There are two Princes, and humanoid chocolates are dancing!
m920156.覚えておけよ料理人ども……。\nそして王子よ……！！:
Remember this, you chefs…
And you, Prince…!!
m920156.認めないから！！\nこのキホルちゃんが、\n人間に助けられたなんて絶対認めないか:
I refuse to accept it!!
There's no way this Kihor
was saved by humans!!
m920156.魔力供給でもしてるんでしょうか！？\n本物の王子さながらの士気高揚ですよ！:
Could it be supplying them with mana!?
It's boosting their morale just like the real Prince would!
m920156.魔王ガリウスは、もういないんだよ！\nみんな物質界で、一緒に生きていこうとしてる:
Demon King Garius is gone!
We're all trying to live together in the Material World!
m920156.魔界アリの女王……！\nオスにしか効かないフェロモンで、\n女王蜘蛛を操ったって:
The Demon Ant Queen…!
You used pheromones that only work on males
to control the Queen Spider…?
m920156.魔界アリは、明らかにチョコを\n積んだ荷馬車だけを狙っています。\n他の商隊には:
The Demon Realm Ants are clearly targeting only the wagons
loaded with chocolate.
They haven't attacked any other caravans at all.

m920161.(……あそこの二人はいつも通り元気なのに、\n他の子たちは少し及び腰なところがあ:
(……Those two are in their usual good spirits, but
the rest of the girls seem a bit hesitant.
I get why some of them find his appearance unsettling, though……)
m920161.(お酒を飲んだあなたも大概ひど──\nいえ、私が言うことではありませんね):
(You're pretty terrible when you've had a drink too──
No, that's not something I should be saying.)
m920161.(ふむ、海図によればこの付近に島などなかったはず。\nいやしかし、現状そうするし:
(Hmm, according to the charts, there shouldn't be any islands in this area.
But then again, it's true that we have no other choice right now……)
m920161.(まだ、なにも終わってない気がする。\nツキコたちは、嵐の目の中にいるだけ):
(It doesn't feel like anything is over yet.
We're just inside the eye of the storm.)
m920161.(まだお兄ちゃんと一緒にいたいなーとか、\nこれはちょっと言えない雰囲気ですね…:
(I wish I could stay with my brother a little longer……
But it doesn't seem like the right time to say that……?)
m920161.(アナトリアとジークはいつも頼もし過ぎるし、\nアタシはアンデッドなんてもう見慣: (Anatolia and Sieglinde are always way too reliable, and I've seen so many undead that I can't even fake being scared by this……)
m920161.(並み居るアンデッドをバッタバッタと\nなぎ倒しながら言う台詞じゃないのです、\:
(This isn't the kind of thing you say while mowing down
a horde of undead like they're wheat…
From the enemy's perspective, we're basically a natural disaster right now……)
m920161.(強過ぎるのです……もはや敵の方が可哀想です……): (She's way too strong… I feel sorry for the enemy now…)
m920161.(怯えながら王子の腕に抱き着く……、\nそういうのもあるのね、勉強になるわ。\n:
(Clinging to the Prince's arm in fear……
I see, so that's how it is. How educational.
But…… calling it “fear” is a stretch……)
m920161.(隠れながら最後に美味しいトコかっさらえば……): (If I stay hidden and swoop in at the last second, I can snag the best part……)
m920161.(魔界組は平常運転だし……): (The Demon Realm crew is in their usual state, I see……)
m920161.……あそこは緊張感ないわねー。: ……The tension over there is completely gone.
m920161.……あっ、閃いちゃったぁ♪\nはーい、みんなよく聞いてねー♪:
……Ah, I've got it! ♪
Alright, everyone, listen up! ♪
m920161.……あっ！ レオナ様！\nあちらの方に陸地が見えますよ！:
……Ah! Leona!
I can see land over there!
m920161.……おいお前、何か言いたそうだな。: ……Hey, you look like you're about to say something.
m920161.……お主のやり方はあくどいが、\nわしもドルイドの一人として、\nあのヒマワリを:
……Your methods are crooked, but as a fellow druid,
I understand just how hard it is to raise those sunflowers.
m920161.……これも敗者の務めだ。悪かった、謝罪するよ。\n枯らしてしまった花は後日同じ種:
……This is the duty of the defeated. I'm sorry. I apologize.
I'll send the same seeds for the flowers I withered later on.
I've experienced firsthand how painful it is to have your hard work ruined.
m920161.……その必要もないみたいね。\n先手が潰された程度で痺れを切らしたみたい、\n臆:
……Looks like we don't need to.
They seem to have lost their patience after their vanguard was wiped out.
Are they both timid and short-tempered?
m920161.……それじゃあ王子、\nなんだかもう始まってるみたいだし、\n私たちもパーティの:
……Well then, Prince,
it looks like things are already getting started,
so let's head over to the party.
m920161.……それは杞憂だ、司教。\n俺と王子には死ねぬ理由がある。\nだから死なん、簡単:
……That is needless worry, Bishop.
The Prince and I have reasons why we cannot die.
So we won't die. It's that simple.
m920161.……はぁ、おいメフィスト、お前も戦え。\n元はと言えば全部お前のせいだろうが。:
……Sigh. Hey, Mephisto, you fight too.
This is all your fault, after all.
m920161.……ふふっ、それもそうね。\n船の修理も終わってる頃だろうし、\nさっさと陸に上:
……Heh, fair enough.
The ship repairs should be finished by now, too.
Let's head ashore.
m920161.……まったく騒がしいな。\n王国らしいと言えばそれまでだが。:
……Quite a racket.
Then again, it is very much in keeping with the kingdom.
m920161.……やっぱり全部あの人たちに任せて、\n私はのんびりビーチで待機しても──ハッ！:
……I should have just let them handle everything
and waited on the beach, nice and relaxed──Huh!?
m920161.……今回はとんだ災難だったが、\n案外悪くない旅だったと、俺は思う。:
……This was quite a disaster, but
I think it turned out to be a rather good trip, all things considered.
m920161.……少しでも噛まれたら面倒だな、\nおいメフィスト、早く私の盾になれ。\nどうせ:
……If we get even a little bitten, it'll be a nightmare.
Hey, Mephisto, hurry up and be my shield.
You're not going to die anyway, right?
m920161.……当然です、あんな危険な植物……魔物？\n物質界での栽培なんて認めるわけにはい:
……Of course. A plant that dangerous… a monster?
There's no way we can allow it to be cultivated in the Material World.
m920161.……恐ろしいわねあの元帥、\n一言で味方の士気を跳ね上げるなんて。\nまっ、アタ:
……That Marshal is terrifying, isn't she?
One word from her and the whole team's morale soars.
Still, I'm not about to let this one go.
m920161.……死霊術に似た気配を感じるわ。\nみんな気を付けて、あれはアンデッド。\n生者:
I can sense an aura similar to necromancy.
Everyone, be careful. Those are undead.
Living beings must not approach them carelessly.
m920161.……生者は本当に他人の話を聞かないわね。: Living beings really never listen, don't they.
m920161.……致し方なしか。フレイ、\nあの島で船を修理してから帰還する。\n王子、アンナ:
……I suppose that's our only option. Frey,
repair the ship on that island, and then we'll head back.
Prince, Anna, is that acceptable to you?
m920161.──いい加減サメの相手も飽きたわ。\nそろそろ……決着ってのを付けましょうか。:
──I'm getting rather tired of dealing with sharks.
Let's put an end to this……
m920161.──いやはやまさかこの地図にない島の正体が、\nあの未知のアンデッドたちの棲家だ:
──I must say, who would have thought that this island, absent from our maps,
would turn out to be the lair of those unknown undead.
Ha! How utterly fascinating.
m920161.──ううん、違うの。\n激しいだけの雨や風なんかより、\nもっと善くないものが近:
No, that's not it.
Something far worse than just heavy rain and wind is approaching.
m920161.──ううん。悪いやつ、奥に隠れてるよ。: ──Nope. The bad guy is hiding in the back.
m920161.──ったく歯応えがないねぇ、こんなもんかい？: Tsk. Not even a challenge. Is this all you've got?
m920161.──っと、早速お出迎えみたいね。\n歓迎のパーティーを開いてくれるって\n楽しそ:
Oh, looks like we're getting a welcome.
They're throwing a party, but
it doesn't seem like a very cheerful atmosphere.
m920161.──なるほど、アレイダさんにとって殿下は\n憧れのお兄さんのような存在だったので:
──I see, so to Aleida, Your Highness is like an idolized older brother.
Actually, I've been regarded as a sister by Your Highness as well……
m920161.──まったく、海中ってのは動きづらいねぇ。\n陸に戻ったらまた、一から鍛え直すと:
──Honestly, it's so hard to move around underwater.
Once we're back on land, I'm going to start my training over from scratch.
m920161.──エリアス、私たちは見回りをしますよ。\n長旅で体調を崩した者がいるかもしれま:
──Elias, we'll go on a patrol.
Some people may have fallen ill after such a long journey.
m920161.──キャー！ やめてやめて！ あっち行きなさいよぉ！: —Screa! Stop it, stop it! Go away!
m920161.──ッ、周囲に複数の魚影を発見！\nあれは……サハギン！？ 敵襲です！:
Multiple fish signatures detected in the surrounding waters!
Those are…… Sahagin! It's an enemy attack!
m920161.──報告です！ 上空から見た限り、\n船の周囲は陸海共に完全に囲まれています！:
──Reporting! From what I can see from above,
we are completely surrounded by land and sea!
m920161.──大変なのです。オークの英雄と剣聖が\n今からエキシビションマッチをするみたい:
──Oh, it's so exciting! The Ogre Hero and the Sword Saint
are about to have an exhibition match!
This is a must-see! We can't miss it!
m920161.──本当に大変だったし、騒がしかったけど、\n確かに王子とならこんな夏も、悪くは:
──It really was a lot of work, and quite noisy, but
I suppose having a summer like this with you isn't so bad, is it?
m920161.あ、それなら私も同行しますわ。\nメーアさんだけでは少し心配ですし、\nあの子ワ:
Oh, in that case, I'll come along.
I'd be worried about Meer on her own, and
she's like a puppy, I can't just leave her— Wait, is she fast?!
m920161.ああー！？\nメープルたちの育てたお花が、\n本当に全部枯れちゃってるよぉ！:
Ahh!?
All the flowers Maple and the others grew…
they're really all withered!
m920161.あっ──いえ、あの、その、これは違くて。: Ah──I mean, um, well, that's not quite right.
m920161.あっ、あの！ 後方支援役でも、\n一番になれたりはするのでしょうか！？:
Ah, um! Even someone in a rear support role,
could they still come in first?!
m920161.あのアンデッド……人喰いザメでは！？\nおおお、お兄ちゃん！ 助けてくださーい！:
Those undead…… they're man-eating sharks!?
Oh no, Big Brother! Please save us!
m920161.あの二人も忙しないわね……、\n少しぐらいゆっくりすればいいのに。:
Those two are always in such a rush……
They should slow down a little more often.
m920161.あらあら、抜け駆けは駄目ですわよディアナさん♪\nこういうのは公平に、早い者勝ち:
Oh my, no cutting in line, Diana ♪
Let's keep it fair. First come, first served?
m920161.あれは死者の魂を使役してるんじゃなくて、\n死体をそのまま無理やり動かしてるみた:
They aren't commanding the souls of the dead.
It looks like they're forcing the corpses to move as they are.
A crude trick. Not my specialty.
m920161.あんまり気にし過ぎちゃダメよぉ？\n今は全員無事だってことを喜ばなきゃ♪:
Don't worry about it too much, okay?
We should be happy that everyone is safe right now♪
m920161.あーあー船がボロボロだよー！\nもー！ なんなのさあいつらー！:
Ah, the ship is a wreck!
Ugh! What were those things!
m920161.いいや、何でもないさラピス。……ただそうだね、\n我々の夏はまだ、始まったばかり:
No, it's nothing, Lapis. ……That said,
perhaps our summer has only just begun?
m920161.いえ、ここは身分的にも辺境総督である私が適任です。\nええ、総督の名は伊達ではな:
No, by rank, I, the Frontier Governor, am the most suitable candidate.
Yes, I'll show you that the title of Governor is no empty boast.
m920161.いえ全然まったくそんなことはありませんので\n騎士メーアは今から残敵掃討に行って:
No, not at all! Not in the least!
Knight Meer is going to mop up the remaining enemies right now!!!
m920161.いつだって戦場に立つ準備は万全だとも。\nしかし、やはり海中というのは慣れないな:
I am always ready to stand on the battlefield.
However, I am still not used to fighting underwater.
Even with the sea miko's secret arts, my sword swings feel a bit sluggish.
m920161.いや私のせいではないだろう！？\n確かに未知のアンデッドに興奮はしたが、\n別に:
It is not my fault!?
Yes, I was thrilled to encounter unknown undead,
but I certainly didn't summon them!
m920161.いよいよ黒幕のご登場ってわけね、\nどんな面か拝ませてもらおうじゃない。:
So the mastermind is finally making an appearance.
Let's see what kind of face you're hiding.
m920161.うう……あまり怖い顔でないといいのですが……。: Ugh…… I hope it doesn't have a scary face……
m920161.うん♪ それじゃあみんな、\n今日はいーっぱい楽しもうねぇ♪:
Yeah♪ Then, everyone,
let's have a ton of fun today♪
m920161.う～ん、みんなよく頑張ってくれたから、\nお姉さんちょっと悩んじゃうわね～……。:
Hmm, everyone did such a great job, so
Big Sister is a little torn here…….
m920161.えっと……予定とは大分違いますけど、\n改めてドルイド会の方を始めましょうかぁ？:
Um… this is quite different from the plan, but
shall we get started on the druid meeting after all?
m920161.えっと、索敵の結果も戦功に加算されたりは……。\nあっ、いまそういう雰囲気ではな:
Um, does the reconnaissance count toward our battle record……?
Ah, I sense that's not the vibe right now, am I right?
m920161.えー！？ なになに、またぁ！？\nやめてよもー！ しっつこいなぁ！\n船を直すの:
Ehh!? What, what, again!?
Please, no more! You're so persistent!
Repairing the ship is hard work, you know!
m920161.え！？ それってつまりクゥイルさんは、\n私の姉ということに──クゥイルお姉様…:
E-eh? So that means you're my sister, Quill……
Sister Quill……!?
m920161.おおっ、人魚のアンデッドまでいるのかい？\n唆るじゃないか、今すぐにでも調査した:
Oh my, even undead mermaids?
You're teasing me. I want to investigate right now.
m920161.おっ、なんだいあんたらもやる気だねぇ。\nだけどこと勝負ごとに関しちゃ手は抜けな:
Oh, looks like you're all eager too.
But when it comes to a contest, I won't hold back.
If you want it, you'll have to beat me!
m920161.おっと、船乗りが先越されちゃったねぇ。\nこちらも前方に雨雲発見、こりゃあかなり:
Oh my, the sailor got beaten to the punch.
I'm picking up a rain cloud up ahead, and it's a big one.
We might need to change course.
m920161.ぎゃー！？ この泡なんかピリピリしますー！: Eek! These bubbles are giving me the tingles!
m920161.ここはまだ水深が浅めなので深海よりはましですが、\n体力も削られますし、水圧の影:
The water is still relatively shallow here, so it's better than the deep sea,
but it still drains our stamina, and we can't ignore the effects of the water pressure.
m920161.ここは私たち王国ドルイド会の管理する庭園、\nそちらこそここでいったい何をしてい:
This is the garden managed by our Kingdom Druid Society.
What are you doing here, I wonder?
m920161.この島の善くないもの、全部根っこがつながってるの。\nいるよ、悪いのが、海でツキ:
The evil things on this island are all connected at the roots.
There's something bad out there, waiting for us in the sea.
m920161.これ、わらわも働かねばならん空気かの？: Is this one of those situations where I'm expected to work as well?
m920161.これは……迎え撃つしかないようですわね。\nいいでしょう、私の矢の的にして差し上:
This is…… we have no choice but to fight our way out.
Very well. I shall make a target of you all with my arrows.
m920161.ご主人様、お怪我はありませんか？\n人魚の歌によって体調に異変などは……。:
Master, are you hurt?
Did the mermaid's song cause you any discomfort?
m920161.ご主人様の御側にお仕えするはメイドの義務、\n私はただ粛々と、己の義務を遂行する:
Serving at my master's side is a maid's duty.
I simply carry out my duty, as is proper.
m920161.さぁて、メーアも回収したことだし反撃開始といこうか。\nどうだい剣聖殿、どっちが:
Well then, now that we've got Meer back, let's launch our counterattack.
How about it, Sword Saint? Fancy a little contest to see who can take down that chainsaw guy first?
m920161.さあ王子、みんなに号令をお願い。\nここで全部、終わらせてやりましょう？:
Well then, Prince, please give the order.
Let's put an end to all of this right here, shall we?
m920161.さて、先ほどの個体が島の主でないことは、\n上空からの索敵によって判明しているの:
Well, our aerial reconnaissance has confirmed that the specimen we encountered earlier is not the island's master.
It seems they still have their eyes set on our ship.
m920161.さてと、ついに海中の調査に来たわけだけど……。: Well then, it seems we've finally come to investigate the sea…
m920161.さらばだ、王国の商売敵諸君。\n茶会に水を差してすまなかったね。:
Farewell, you merchants of the Kingdom.
I apologize for spoiling your tea party.
m920161.しかし二度も返り討ちに遭った上で、\n群れは壊滅、支配下のアンデッドたちもほぼ全:
Still, after being defeated twice, the horde is destroyed,
and the undead under its control are nearly wiped out.
I hope this teaches them not to oppose us again.
m920161.しっかしなんだいあの変なサハギン、\nメルアビスは何か知ってるのかい？:
But what were those strange Sahagin?
Do you know anything about them, Melabyss?
m920161.そ、そんなこと言わなくてもいいじゃないですか！\n私だって敵から逃げるのに必死な:
Y-you don't have to say that!
I'm trying my best to escape the enemy too!
m920161.そうかい？ どんなに強いやつが相手でも、\n絶対にへこたれない人間がすぐ近くにい:
Is it? No matter how strong the opponent,
there's a human right here who never gives up, isn't there?
m920161.そうですね……これ以上の日程の遅延は、\nメイドとして看過できるものではありませ:
Yes…… any further delay in our schedule
is something a maid cannot simply overlook.
m920161.そうね、でもまだ油断はできないわ。\nみんなも周囲の警戒は怠らないように──:
I suppose so, but we can't let our guard down yet.
Everyone, keep watching your surroundings──
m920161.そう言いたいのはこっちの方なんじゃがのぉ。\nお主とて、ほんにどこにでも現れるで:
If anyone's complaining, it's us.
You just seem to pop up everywhere, don't you?
m920161.そこの狐さん魔神さんデーモンさーん！\n今は人手が全然足りないんですからー！\n:
Hey, fox lady, demon god, and demon over there!
We're seriously short on hands right now!
We're going to hold down that side!
m920161.そっ、逃げ足の速いこと。\n引き際を誤らない程度の知能はあるみたいね。:
Wow, they're quick on the uptake.
They must have just enough intelligence to know when to cut their losses.
m920161.そっちは後衛陣地ですメーア！ こっちこっち、早く！: That's the rear line, Meer! Over here, hurry!
m920161.それじゃあそこんとこも注意して。\n王子、とびっきりの指示をお願いね？:
So, keep that in mind.
Prince, we're counting on your brilliant commands?
m920161.それはこちらの台詞ですよ。\n海巫女であるリバンさんが船に乗っていなければ、\n:
That's what I should be saying.
If it weren't for our sea miko, Liban, being on board,
we would have been completely helpless against the enemies in the water.
m920161.それはオークがおかしいのよ。本当に戦闘種族ね。: That's because orcs are strange. They really are a warrior race.
m920161.だが悪いねドルイド諸君、\nここに咲いていた花は全て枯れてしまったよ。\nワシの:
But I'm sorry, Druids.
All the flowers that bloomed here have withered.
They lost the competition for survival against my sunflowers.
m920161.ちょうどチェーンソーを持ったアンデッドを\nこの剣で是非斬りたいと思っていたとこ:
I was just thinking I'd like to cut down that chainsaw-wielding undead
with my sword.
Everyone, I'll take that head for myself.
m920161.ちょっと困ったことになったわね。\n食糧や水の問題もあるからあまり時間も掛けられ:
This is a bit of a predicament.
We can't afford to waste time, given the food and water situation.
I suspect there's a mastermind controlling the corpses somewhere…….
m920161.であれば、今度こそ一旦休憩と致しましょう。\nはい、ここからが私の本領発揮と言え:
In that case, it's time for a proper rest.
Yes, this is where I truly shine.
m920161.ですが相当の痛手は与えました。\n多少なり回る頭を持っているのならば、\nこれ以:
However, we have dealt them a significant blow.
If they have even a shred of common sense, they should realize that further interference is futile.
m920161.では、私たちは船の防備を固めましょう。\nまたいつ襲撃があるかも分かりませんし。:
Then we'll reinforce the ship's defenses.
We don't know when the next attack will come.
m920161.では私は宴の余興として踊りでも……、\n誰か一緒に歌ってくれると嬉しいのですが。:
Then I'll perform a dance for the feast's entertainment……
It would be lovely if someone would sing with me.
m920161.どうかしらね、特別な個体なのは間違いないけど。: Hard to say. It's definitely a special specimen, though.
m920161.どうしたのツキコ──って、この気配は！: What is it, Tsukiko──wait, this presence!
m920161.どうやら奴の泡には麻痺毒が含まれているらしい。\nふふ……嵐の海に未知のサハギン:
It seems their bubbles contain a paralytic poison.
Heh…… Unknown Sahagin in a stormy sea. What a dire situation.
m920161.どこに敵が潜んでいるかわかりませんからね、\n海中でなければ私が飛んで索敵できる:
We have no idea where the enemies are lurking.
If we weren't underwater, I could have flown up to scout the area.
m920161.なっ、なにがヒマワリですか！？\nどう見ても魔物じゃないですか！！:
W-What do you mean sunflowers!?
They're obviously monsters!
m920161.なにせもしこの船が沈んじゃってたら、\nまず間違いなく世界が滅んじゃうもの♪:
After all, if this ship had sunk,
the world would almost certainly have been destroyed♪
m920161.なんですのー！？ なんなんですのー！？\nあんなの聞いてませんわ！ 激ヤバですわ:
What is that?! What is that?!
I didn't sign up for this! This is way too dangerous!!
m920161.はぁ……私も付き添いで来てよかった。\nメープル、先にヒマワリの方を止めるよ。\:
Haa… I'm glad I came along as backup.
Maple, let's stop the sunflowers first.
It'll be a real headache if they manage to bloom…
m920161.はいはい、みなさん気を抜いては駄目ですわよ？\nここはまだ敵地のど真ん中というこ:
Now then, now then, everyone, don't let your guard down, all right?
Don't forget that we're still right in the heart of enemy territory.
m920161.はいはい、治療するからじっとしてくださいねー。: There, there. I'll treat you, so please hold still.
m920161.はいはい！ 休暇のほかにご褒美も欲しいです！\nみんなでパーティしましょう！ パ:
Yes, yes! We want rewards besides leave, too!
Let's have a party! A paaaarty!
m920161.はっはっはっ！ まぁいいじゃないか、\nあれぐらいお気楽な方が雰囲気も明るくなる:
Hahaha! Well, that's fine.
A little lightheartedness brightens the mood.
Being able to laugh even on the battlefield is a good thing.
m920161.はっはー！ 歯応えがありそうじゃないか！\nいいねぇ、食い散らかしてやろうじゃな:
Hah-ha! They look like they'll put up a good fight!
Great, I'll tear them all apart!
m920161.はー、王子さまたちが来てくれて良かったですわ。\nこの近海はどこもかしこもアンデ:
Phew, I'm so glad you all came, Your Highnesses.
The waters nearby are teeming with undead,
so I couldn't even take a proper bath on my own.
m920161.はーいではありません、あなたはこっちです。\nなんですかその騎士団でも見せない無:
Don't say “yes” so casually, you're on my side.
What is that useless, overly enthusiastic response? Are you trying to impress a knightly order or something?
m920161.はーい！ 今日も王国ドルイド会！\nゲストに王子さまとお姉ちゃんを招いて、\nお:
Hii! Welcome to the Kingdom Druid Society!
We've invited Prince and Sis as guests to start our tea party and gardening session♪
m920161.びぇぇぇんっ！ だっ、誰か助けてくださーい！\nチェーンソーが、チェーンソー男が:
Eeeeeek! H-help! S-someone help me!
The chainsaw guy is chasing me!
m920161.ふぅ……ひとまずは落ち着けそうですね。\n……リーゼロッテさん？ どうかしました:
Phew… things seem to be settling down for now.
…Lieselotte? Is something wrong?
m920161.ふぅむ、ワシの密かな趣味を邪魔するのかね？\nいいだろう、相手になってあげようじ:
Hmm, so you intend to interfere with my secret hobby?
Very well. I'll grant you a battle.
m920161.ふふ、皆様たくさん活躍されていますけれど、\n海の中であれば私だって負けはしませ:
Hehe, you've all been doing wonderfully,
but I wouldn't lose to anyone in the water either♪
m920161.ふふっ、ご飯の時間が楽しみね。\nそれじゃあ王子、船に戻りましょうか。: Heh, I'm looking forward to dinner. Well then, Prince, shall we head back to the ship?
m920161.ふむ、なんだい君たちは？\nワシの花き農場に何か用かね？:
Hm, what do you want?
Do you have some business on my flower farm?
m920161.ふむ、悪くない提案だが大丈夫か？\nオークの英雄の戦歴に傷が付いてしまうぞ？:
Hm, not a bad idea. But are you sure you're up for it?
Losing to me would be a blemish on the record of the Orc Hero, wouldn't it?
m920161.ふん、庭仕事は趣味の範囲に留めておくさ。\n今の生き方を変えるつもりも、野望を捨:
Hmph, I'll keep gardening to my hobbies.
I have no intention of changing my way of life, nor of abandoning my ambitions.
My plan to place every shop in this world under my control continues as planned.
m920161.へぇ、ようやく骨のありそうな奴が出たね。\nもしかして、あいつがこの島の親玉なの:
Hm, finally some worthy prey.
Could it be that thing is the boss of this island?
m920161.ほ、本当に人喰いザメですっ！\nみなさん気を付けてくださ──え？\nお兄ちゃん？:
T-They really are man-eating sharks!
Everyone, please be care──Wait?
Big Brother? You mean the Prince?
m920161.まあ……確かにね──って、\n今回の場合それだと困るって言ってんの！\nほら、み:
Well…… I suppose you're right──
But in this case, that's exactly the problem!
Come on, everyone, let's head back to the ship.
m920161.まあ待て、食べやすいよう私が三枚におろしてやる。: Hold on, I'll fillet them into three pieces so they're easier to eat.
m920161.またアンデッドの群れですか……。\nそれでツキコさん、メルアビスさん、\nあの敵:
Another horde of undead…
Tsukiko, Melabyss,
is the mastermind behind this among that group?
m920161.まっ、王子へのアピールは後ってことで。\n今は悪いサメ退治に励むとしましょうか。:
Well, I'll save my charm offensive for the Prince for later.
For now, let's focus on hunting down these nasty sharks.
m920161.むぅ……ワシが丹精込めて育て上げた\n魔界ヒマワリちゃんが全滅するとは……。\n:
Mmph… To think all the Demon Realm sunflowers
I nurtured with such care are wiped out…
My dream of expanding into the Material World is shattered.
m920161.むふー！ 謝ってくれたならいいよ、許してあげる！: Mmph! Well, since you apologized, I forgive you!
m920161.もう全部あの人に任せちゃダメですかね？: Can't we just leave it all to her?
m920161.もちろんありますよー！\nあとで持って来ますねー！: Of course! I'll bring some over later!
m920161.やっぱり、囲まれてる、よね？: I knew it. We're surrounded, aren't we?
m920161.やめときなさい、お腹壊すわよ。: Don't do that, you'll get a stomachache.
m920161.よく言った！ 確かにその通りさ剣聖殿！\nそれじゃ、ちょっくらあいつらを助けると:
Well said! You're right, Sword Saint!
Then let's go help those two!
m920161.わ、わ、わー！ 船に乗り込んできます！\nしかも見た目がいつものと全然違いますよ:
Wh-Wh-Whoa! They're boarding the ship!
And they look completely different from the usual ones!
m920161.わかったよお姉ちゃん！\nよーし、まっけないぞぉ！:
Got it, Sis!
Alright, I won't lose!
m920161.んー……ちょっと厳しいね、\nこのままだと帰る前に沈んじゃうよ。\nどこかで一旦:
Hmm…… this is going to be tough.
If we keep it up like this, we'll sink before we even get home.
We need to find a place to make repairs.
m920161.アタシも戦うわ。冥霊魔術師として、\nこいつらは存在そのものが気に入らない。:
I'm fighting too. As a Nether Spirit Mage,
I simply can't stand the very existence of these things.
m920161.アンデッドが怖かったらあたしの後ろに来なよ。\n全員まとめて守ってやるから安心し:
If you're scared of the undead, come stand behind me.
I'll protect all of you, so just leave it to me!
m920161.オッケー決まりだね。\nそれじゃ帝国水兵の誇りに懸けまして、\nあの島までは保た:
Okay, it's settled.
Then, for the pride of the Imperial Navy,
I'll keep us afloat until we reach that island!
m920161.オークだったら喜び勇んで再戦を挑むんだけどねぇ。: If it were an orc, it would be thrilled to take another shot at us.
m920161.グリフィンも海中は苦手みたいなんですよねぇ。: Griffins don't seem to do very well underwater, either.
m920161.サメのアンデッド、いやゾンビシャークかな？\nきっとサハギンの比ではないほどの強:
Shark undead, or should I say zombie sharks?
They must be carrying a paralytic poison far more potent than anything the Sahagin produce!
Oh, how intriguing!
m920161.ゾンビシャーク……こんなたくさん仲間がいたのね、\n今度は群れで襲撃なんて、やっ:
Zombie sharks…… I had no idea there were so many of them.
Attacking in a pack, how delightfully persistent.
m920161.ダメ、王子さまは、ツキコが導くの……。: No, the Prince is meant to be guided by Tsukiko…….
m920161.チッ……これだから知識欲の魔神というやつは、\nお前が楽しそうだといつもロクなこ:
Tch…… This is why I hate it when a demon god's curiosity gets the better of him.
Every time you look this excited, something bad happens.
m920161.ツキコは、王子さまを導くだけだけど、\nみんなのために、ちょっと頑張る、よ？: I'm only here to guide you, Prince, but I'll do my best for everyone, okay?
m920161.ツキコー？ 置いてっちゃうわよー！: Tsukiko? We're leaving you behind, you know!
m920161.ハッ、歌は人間にしか効かないんだろう？\nみんな休んでな、あたしが暴れてやるよ。:
Hah, the song only works on humans, right?
Everyone rest up. I'll handle the chaos.
m920161.パーティと聞いてユッタ参上！\nさあ、みんなでお肉を食べましょう！:
Jutta is here for the party!
Come on, let's eat some meat together!
m920161.メーアさんって、そのうち何かの拍子に\n上官への失言で降格させられそうですわね…:
At this rate, Meer is going to get demoted
for talking back to her superiors before long, isn't she?
m920161.メーアちゃん？ それはサボりたいってことかしら？: Meer? Are you saying you want to slack off?
m920161.メーアとクリスタが追いかけられて……、\n──って、こここ、こっち来たぁぁぁっ！:
Meer and Christa are being chased…
—Wait, they're coming this way?!
m920161.メープルは優しいね、えらいえらい。: Maple, you're so kind. Good girl, good girl.
m920161.レオナちゃん！\nそれもそうねぇ、何か分かったことはあるかしらぁ？:
Leona-chan!
You're right, of course. Did you find out anything?
m920161.一つの船に二国の要人を乗せ過ぎでしたからね、\n正直に言うと道中は気が気でありま:
We really shouldn't have put the leaders of two nations
on a single ship. To be honest, I was on edge the whole way……
m920161.一匹、取り逃しちゃったみたいね。\nまったく、逃げ足だけは速いんだから。:
Looks like we let one get away.
Honestly, it was fast enough to make a mockery of us.
m920161.一時はどうなることかと思いましたが、\n無事に島を脱出することができましたね。:
I thought things were going to go badly for a moment,
but it looks like we managed to evacuate from the island safely.
m920161.乗っ取りや買収だのつまらんことは言わず、\nお主も物質界で花を育ててみる気はない:
Put aside your talk of takeovers and buyouts.
How about you try growing flowers in the material world?
I wouldn't mind lending you an ear from time to time.
m920161.今回の栽培が上手く行けば本格的に事業を立ち上げ、\n物質界に展開させるのも悪くな:
If this trial cultivation had gone well, I was considering launching a full-scale business
and expanding into the Material World.
m920161.今後の計画は大幅に狂わされたがな。\nこんな長期で国を空けることになるとは……、:
Our plans for the future have been thrown completely into disarray.
I never expected to be away from the country for this long……
Just thinking about what's waiting for us when we get back gives me a headache.
m920161.今日は時間がないが、次は酒を持って来る。\n……ではな、王子。:
I don't have time today, but I'll bring some alcohol next time.
……Well then, Prince.
m920161.今日もお花さんは元気かなぁ──って、\nええっ！？ し、知らない人がいますよぉ！:
I hope the flowers are doing well today──Wait,
Wh-Who's that? There's a stranger here!
m920161.付近の植生を丸ごと崩壊させるほどの外来種……、\nそんなものが広まれば世界中が混:
An invasive species capable of collapsing the local flora entirely…
if something like that spread, the whole world would be thrown into chaos!
m920161.何だって構わんさ、斬れば分かる。: It doesn't matter. I'll find out when I cut it down.
m920161.僭越ながら、私がお引き受けしましょう。\nメイドたる者、芸事にも多少覚えがありま:
If you'll allow me, I shall take that on.
As a maid, I have a fair amount of skill in the arts.
m920161.全員、気合は十分みたいだねぇ……！\n最後の大一番だ、派手に行こうじゃないか！:
Everyone seems ready to give it their all……!
This is the final battle, so let's make it a spectacular one!
m920161.参りましたね……今回の夏の合同演習も、\nあとはもう国へ帰還するだけだったのです: I'm afraid so…… We were just about to head back to the country after this summer's joint exercise.
m920161.友人にその言い方はどうかと思うなー！: I think that's a bit harsh for a friend!
m920161.合同訓練は慰安も兼ねていたはずなのですが、\nなんだか出発前よりどっと疲れてしま:
The joint training was supposed to include some relaxation,
but I feel even more exhausted than before we set out.
m920161.周囲の警戒は私の方で担当しておきますので、\n皆様も少しぐらいは気を抜かれても大:
I'll take care of the perimeter watch,
so please feel free to relax a little, everyone.
m920161.国の工房でくぐつの本格的なメンテナンスを……、\n潮と海に晒し過ぎると錆が気にな:
I need to get a thorough maintenance done on the nest at the kingdom's workshop……
Leaving it exposed to the salt spray and the sea makes me worry about rust.
m920161.姉さん、それよりも先にすることがあるだろう……。: Sis, there are more pressing matters to attend to…….
m920161.実は船の貴賓室が壊されちゃって修理中でねぇ？\nだからこの戦いで戦功一番の子には:
As it happens, the ship's VIP room got wrecked and is under repair, right?
So whoever racks up the most battle points in this fight will get a special prize~
The right to share a room with the Prince! ♪
m920161.感心している場合ではありませんわよ。\n最初のサハギンの襲撃とはワケが違います、:

It is a threat of nature itself, not the work of human hands…….
It is on a scale that could be fatal if caught in it.
m920194.人生最後の戦いは、\nなんの憂いもしがらみもなく、\n殺し合ってみたいものだな、: I'd like our final battle to be free of any regrets or burdens. A simple duel to the death, you and I.
m920194.今のあやつは人でありながら精霊でもある。\n王子よ、心してかかれ。:
Right now, he is both human and spirit.
Prince, be on your guard.
m920194.余裕ぶってないで！ 迎撃するわよ！\n王子、あいつも小規模な砂嵐を発生させてるみ:
Stop being so casual! Let's intercept them!
Prince, it looks like that one is generating a small sandstorm too.
m920194.俺様は王子を気に入った。\n戦いぶり、遠征の逸話、戦場の有り様、\nすべてをくま:
I have taken a liking to the Prince.
Report everything to me without omission:
his fighting style, his expedition anecdotes, the state of the battlefield.
m920194.光栄だ、戦神マレス。: I am honored, War God Mares.
m920194.加護……えっ、亜神の加護ですかぁ！？\nそんな簡単に貰っちゃっていいんです？:
Blessings…… wait, blessings from a Lesser God!?
Can we really just receive them that easily?
m920194.加護の力はいずれも、戦士の力をより高めるものだ。\n「交換所」の「戦神の加護」に:
Each blessing serves to further enhance a warrior's strength.
You can choose the one you wish to receive
at the "Exchange" under "Blessings of the War God."
m920194.合理的ですが、乱戦が過ぎるかと。\n――ところで、こんなものを拾ったのですが。:
It's logical, but it might be a bit too chaotic.
――By the way, I picked this up.
m920194.命の奪い合いでも、領地の奪い合いでもない、\n純粋な武を競い合うお祭り、ですか…:
A festival where we compete purely in martial prowess,
with no lives or territories at stake, is it……?
Hehe, I'm so glad to see you having fun, Prince♪
m920194.外敵あらば妖霊にて薙ぎ払い、\n国に巣食う虫あらば、同胞とて手に掛ける。:
If an external enemy appears, he sweeps them away with his spirits.
If pests infest the nation, he kills them, even if they are his own people.
m920194.妖霊使いは――おや？ 消えた？: The spirit user is――hmm? He's gone?
m920194.妖霊使いよ、\n戦士としては少々気に入らぬが、\n戦略家としての実力は大いに認め:
Spirit user,
I take a certain dislike to you as a warrior,
but I must acknowledge your skill as a strategist.
m920194.姉様のどこが狂犬ですか！\nホルテウス様とて許しませんよ！: What do you mean "Mad Dog," Sister! I won't allow you to say that, Horteus!
m920194.巨大な砂嵐に比べたら大したことないけど、\nまとわりつかれている間は\nまともに:
It's nothing compared to the massive sandstorm, but
as long as it's clinging to you,
you won't be able to move properly.
m920194.巻き込まれそうな場所にいる人は、\n即座に退避したほうが良さそうですね……。\n:
Those in areas likely to be caught in it
should evacuate immediately, I think…….
Everyone, please be careful!
--- scene: Sand Elemental (battle, battle) ---
m920194.待ちわびただろう、この時を。\nあぁそうだ、俺様も待っていた。:
You must have been waiting for this moment.
Yes, I have been waiting too.
m920194.待って姉様！ まだ姉様は負けてないです！\nわ、私が膝をついてしまっただけで――: Wait, Sister! You haven't lost yet! I'm the only one who's on my knees, after all――
m920194.待てプロエ、「栄誉」がどこへ行く。: Hold on, Ploe. Where is the “Honor” going?
m920194.後はただ、祈るがいい。\n俺様にではない。己が信ずる鍛錬の日々に祈りを捧げよ。:
Now, just pray.
Not to me. Offer your prayers to the days of training you believe in.
m920194.感慨深いものでしょう、元兵士長殿。\n後進が育ち、独り立ちしている姿をみるのは。:
It must be a moving sight, former Sergeant Major.
To see your successors grown up and standing on their own.
m920194.慌てるな、戦神にして軍神たる者よ。\n戦いには物語が、\n物語には順序が必要だろ:
Do not panic, you who are a War God and a God of War.
A battle requires a story,
and a story requires order, would you not agree?
m920194.戦いとは物語である！\nそして物語とは、決して終わること無く紡がれ続ける！:
War is a story!
And a story is one that is woven on, forever without end!
m920194.戦神コロッセウム、本戦。\nついにその時がやってきたー。:
The War God Colosseum, the main event.
The time has finally come—
m920194.戦神マレスが手塩にかけて育てた戦士、\n戦の聖霊たる貴様を、王国への大使として常:
I shall station the warrior I have nurtured with such care,
you, a Sacred Spirit of War, as a permanent ambassador to the Kingdom.
Get along well with Vulcano.
m920194.本当にすまない……。\n本来ならもう少し、丁寧に説明をしたかったのだが……。:
I am truly sorry……
I would have liked to explain things a bit more properly, but……
m920194.歓声の中、父なる陽光のもとで、\n己がすべての実力を振るうという初めての舞台に、:
Amidst the cheers, under the light of the father sun,
on this first stage where he can unleash his full power,
he is simply overjoyed.
m920194.決して表に出ることなく、栄誉も汚名も持たぬ者。\nされど、王子とホルエス様のおか:
A man who never steps into the light, bearing neither glory nor infamy.
Yet, thanks to the Prince and Lord Horus,
he, too, has been given the chance to stand on the stage.
m920194.決勝戦を戦うは、王国の王子、\nそして砂漠の妖霊使いに決まった！\n――観客ども:
The final match will be fought by the Kingdom's Prince,
and the Desert's spirit user!
――Spectators, shout the names of your heroes!!
m920194.熟練兵に引退されては困ります。\nまだもうしばらく、こき使われてもらいますよ。: We can't afford to lose a veteran like you to retirement. You'll have to keep working for us for a while longer.
m920194.王子、あやつの妖霊はニ種。\n渦巻く風のジン、そしてランプの精たるシャイターン。:
Prince, his spirits are of two kinds.
The Jinn of the swirling wind, and the Genie of the lamp, the Shaitan.
m920194.王子、すでに戦いは始まっています！\n迅速な指揮をお願いします！:
Prince, the battle has already begun!
Please issue your commands swiftly!
m920194.王子よ、人類最強決定戦・砂漠の部、\nその初代優勝者は貴様だ。\n見事……実に見:
Prince, in the Strongest of Humanity Tournament, Desert Division,
you are the first champion.
Magnificent… truly a magnificent fight!
m920194.砂のエレメンタラー、撃破を確認。\nだいぶ敵の数も減ってきたな。:
Sand Elemental defeated, confirmed.
The enemy numbers have decreased considerably.
m920194.砂漠に勝利を！ 砂漠の嵐に勝利をッ！！: Victory to the Desert! Victory to the Desert Storm!!
m920194.砂漠の大樹、我が豪剣、\n英雄王の系譜にどこまで届くか――試させてもらう！: The Great Tree of the Desert, my mighty sword――let us see how far it can reach against the lineage of the Hero King!
m920194.砂漠の妖霊使いに伝わる秘術、\n己と精霊を一体化し、さらなる力を得る奥義か。:
A secret art passed down among the desert spirit users,
a supreme technique that merges one's self with the spirit to gain even greater power.
m920194.砂漠の狂犬姉妹、見事な戦いだったぞ。\n戦場にあっても冷静な視点を失わない、\n:
The Desert Mad Dog Sisters, what a magnificent fight.
Even on the battlefield, you never lost your cool perspective.
You possess both fiery martial skill and a cold heart. You are fine warriors.
m920194.祈り、願い、決意……。\n戦いに挑む理由は数多あれど、\nそれはただ、ひとつしか:
Prayers, wishes, resolve…
There are many reasons to enter battle,
but only one of them can be fulfilled.
m920194.精霊に己が身を守らせ、\n最後の最後まで生き延びる手法は、\n戦場にて磨き上げた:
Having spirits shield your body,
and surviving to the very last moment,
that is undoubtedly a survival technique honed on the battlefield.
m920194.精霊をぶっ倒す！\nそうすれば、術者本体も倒せるはずよ！:
We take down the spirits!
If we do that, we should be able to defeat the user herself!
m920194.見よ、数多くの猛者たちが、\n王子との戦いを求めてこの地へ集った！！:
Behold, many fierce warriors
have gathered here seeking battle with the Prince!!
m920194.覚悟が最初から決まっているというか、\n戦いと日常が地続きになっているというか…:
It's as if their resolve is set from the very start,
or as if battle and daily life are one and the same……
m920194.言われるまでもない。\n王子、貴公の実力はファルアからよく聞いている。\n手合わ: I don't need to be told twice. Prince, I've heard much about your skill from Falua. I'd be honored to test my blade against yours.
m920194.負けは負けだ、ファルア。\nこれ以上は命の奪い合いになってしまう。: A loss is a loss, Falua. Any further, and this becomes a fight to the death.
m920194.貴様、妖霊使いか……。\n敗北を認めた者に刃を向けるとは、\n戦士の矜持もないら:
You… a spirit user, are you?
To turn your blade on someone who has already conceded defeat?
You have no warrior's pride at all.
m920194.転移まで時間がほとんどなくて、\n駆け足で説明した、ってところか？\n亜神っての:
We had almost no time before the teleport,
so I guess I rushed through the explanation?
Sub-gods are always so self-centered. It's a pain.
m920194.魔界武術大会ぶりかねぇ……。\nこんな声援の中で戦うのは。:
It's been a while since the Demon Realm Martial Arts Tournament, huh…
Fighting under all this cheering.
m920194.（あれが熟練兵の余裕ってやつだ。\n私たちも負けないように、もっと強くならないと: (That's the composure of a true veteran. We need to get stronger so we don't fall behind.)
m920194.（わっ、わー、雑談しながら\n敵をばったばったなぎ倒してますよ！？）: (Wh-Whoa, they're mowing down enemies like it's nothing while chatting!?)
m920194.２位の栄光はいらない……いや、違うな。\nただこの戦いに挑み、勝ち抜き、\n王子:
He doesn't want the glory of second place… no, that's not it.
It means that challenging this battle, fighting to the end,
and losing to the Prince was enough for him.
